description: This Java source file defines a final class 'RequestTimeoutHandlingDirective' which provides an Akka HTTP directive for handling request timeouts. It manages timing, logging, and response handling for HTTP requests, particularly when a request times out. The class encapsulates logic for checking duration warnings and constructing timeout responses.

classes.name: RequestTimeoutHandlingDirective
classes.description: Provides an Akka HTTP directive to handle request timeouts, including timing, logging, alerting, and generating timeout responses.
